scope: Offline replay of the exact 100-source development frame, all 20 fixed controls, cached archive evidence and all 14 context actions; no new source acquisition or event-ledger replacement
acceptance_normalization: Retain raw header values only. Source-specific timezone semantics remain unverified; no ET/UTC conversion or registered public time is supplied.
archive_scope: Only the cached contiguous 33 MiB compressed prefix. Revalidate ranges and replay the registered verifier; no membership absence or dissemination guarantee from a partial archive.
control_crosscheck: All fixed control visible texts; repurchase/buyback, common-share purchase/acquisition, board-approval/common-share proximity. Up to 250 cue excerpts per component with total-hit and truncation counts. Cues are not event labels.
development_exposure: The fixed corpus and one control keyword paragraph have already been inspected. This is a source-integrity/cue audit, not independent factual QA or untouched model evaluation.
review_frame: All 14 existing action-context records, including the ASR context, deduplicated into their original source filings, plus all 20 fixed source controls. This prepares an unassigned full-source development review bundle, not final QA or a replacement for the original 718-record frame.
reviewer_blinding: No proposed labels, scores, prior owner decisions or per-source sampling role in reviewer packets. Non-text components remain visible as coverage limitations.
